method: RIDB facilities pinned at 0,0 (the 2026-09-21 lower-48 filter dropped them). audit/ridb_gap_zero_2026-09-28.json -> ridb_gap_triage.py --gap -> rec.gov /api/camps/campgrounds/<id> for a real pin (RIDB has none; rec.gov does for most) -> name + pin dedup.

added.name: Idlewild Campground
added.caveat: FS says trailers 20 ft and under; six dated reviews 2020-2026 fit 23-36 ft rigs in 4-5 larger sites

added.name: Walla Walla Forest Camp
added.caveat: no agency length; one 2016 review, 23-ft trailer

added.name: Williamson Campground
added.caveat: no agency length; reviewers fit 23- and 31-ft trailers

added.name: Turkey Flat Forest Camp
added.caveat: no agency length; one 2016 review, 23-ft trailer; rough road past the guard station

added.name: Buck Creek Campground
added.caveat: shared with stock users (hitching rails, loading ramp); FS: 60-ft parking welcomes long RVs

added.name: Rio Grande
added.caveat: steep narrow access, FS not recommended for large RVs; 33-ft Class A reported 2020

added.name: Lost Creek Campground (WY)
added.caveat: FS: trailers under 22 ft; catalog driveways 25-99 ft - EKKO at the stated edge

added.name: Oak Ridge (Ok)
added.caveat: most electric sites short; pin from the Dyrt listing checked on satellite

added.name: Wichita Ridge Campground
added.caveat: narrow road; 35-ft figure from the Dyrt listing, not the agency

added.name: Cove Creek (AR)
added.caveat: pin moved ~250 m from Good Sam's onto the peninsula; loops under canopy

added.name: Dam Site East (Ok)
added.caveat: pin from allstays checked on satellite (Good Sam's was 1.5 km off, on the wrong bank)

excluded.name: Canyon Forest Camp

excluded.why: same campground judged in ridb_gap_co_nocatalog_decisions (Aspen, Gould): FS maximum trailer 20 ft

excluded.name: Brown Creek Campground
excluded.why: same campground judged in ridb_gap_wa_nocatalog_decisions: RV/trailer sites up to 21 ft

excluded.name: Bottle Creek Campground (WY)
excluded.why: FS: '16 small campsites (trailers less than 16 feet)' although catalog driveways measure 23-52 ft; only reviewer rig a van. Recheck if the FS statement changes

excluded.name: Seven Devils Campground
excluded.why: FS: 9-10 tent-only sites

excluded.name: Pines Campground (CO)
excluded.why: FS: maximum trailer length 20 ft

excluded.name: Black Lake Campground
excluded.why: FS: 4 tent sites; access road 'steep and rough... not recommended for RVs, trailers or low clearance vehicles'

excluded.name: Bull Mountain Campground
excluded.why: minimally developed, no numbered sites, tables or fire rings; road closed Nov 15-Jun 15; no length from any source

excluded.name: Moneka North Campground
excluded.why: 38 non-electric sites with no stated length; Dyrt reviews 2018/2021: small sites among large trees, 'larger rigs would not be able to park', no turnarounds. Good Sam's pin lands in scrub south of the dam and no loop is legible

excluded.name: Leroys Ferry Campground
excluded.why: every catalog site's permitted equipment is 'POP UP' only; the park is in SC (McCormick County), not GA

excluded.name: Milltown Campground
excluded.why: no-catalog rec.gov record; the Corps campground was leased to Hart County in 2014 as a day-use park without camping, and only stale aggregator listings remain
